key.name: open-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens Mei with the message box focused. An empty list turns it off.

key.name: ask-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens a new Mei chat with the focused window's title and the selected text attached. An empty list turns it off.

key.name: voice-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that starts listening. Press it again when you're done talking, or while Mei speaks to stop it and talk. An empty list turns it off.

key.name: stop-computer-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that stops computer use at once: no more clicks or typing from Mei, and the task stops. An empty list turns it off.
